transparent_keys.scoring_note: Classifications are informational only. The compiled fitness kernel applies a sigmoid-weighted effort-proportional penalty to ALL empty positions on reachable non-L0/non-L7 layers regardless of classification. There is no reward for intentional_fallthrough and no exemption for acceptable_empty — position effort determines penalty magnitude.
